# Report - round 001 (initial)

Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (native protocol); not equivalent to Blender model rankings.

Observed (from the 24 reference samples): a single jogger (black T-shirt, white shorts, white socks) runs along the curved floor of a centrifuge-like ring corridor. Three shots: (1) 0 to ~7.8 s high rear follow shot looking down the curving walkway past consoles and black swivel chairs, with occasional raised-fist gestures; (2) ~7.8 to ~15.1 s low frontal camera looking up at the jogger who shadowboxes toward the camera while hibernation pods recede up the curve behind him; (3) ~15.1 s to end, low rear camera following him toward the hibernation pods; lighting gets bluer at the end. Two large rounded overhead fixtures with blue glow stay fixed in frame in all shots.

Geometry: drum floor = inner surface of a cylinder (R 5.5 m) with flat end walls; consoles, cabinets and pod frames are boxes bent along the floor; chairs are box/cylinder proxies; pods are scaled spheres in dark frames; the overhead fixtures are non-rotating discs with ring trim, and the blue glow is emissive side panels.

Articulation: jogger hierarchy (hips, torso, head, shoulders/elbows, hips/knees/ankles) with an analytical running cycle (1.4 Hz), arm swing in shots 1/3, guard plus alternating upward punches in shot 2 timed to the samples.

Camera and timing: the jogger stays at the drum bottom while the drum rotates analytically (about 0.4 rad/s in shots 1 and 3, 0.29 rad/s in shot 2) so the environment streams past at the observed rates; per-shot fixed camera rigs, hard cuts at 7.85 s and 15.1 s (cut times are inferred between samples). Sector A (consoles) is shown in shot 1 and sector B (pods) in shots 2 and 3; the ring layout is not claimed to be globally consistent across cuts.

Inferred / unverified: exact cut frames, motion between samples, punch timings between samples, lens FOV (55 deg vertical assumed). No render feedback received yet.

rounds.reason: Refit all three camera rigs, enlarge overhead housings per shot, fix posture/arms and lighting contrast.

Articulation: jogger hierarchy (hips, torso, head, shoulders/elbows, hips/knees/ankles) with analytical running cycle (1.4 Hz); forward lean in shots 1/3 (strong in 3), high-knee jog with guard and alternating upward punches in shot 2, timed to samples.

Camera and timing: jogger fixed at drum bottom; drum rotates analytically (0.4 rad/s shots 1 and 3, 0.29 rad/s shot 2). Cameras were re-fitted in this round from jogger landmarks with a 50 deg vertical FOV: shot 1 at 3.2 m high, 2.8 m behind, pitch -32 deg; shot 2 0.55 m high, 1.4 m in front, pitch +24.5 deg; shot 3 0.8 m high, 0.55 m behind, pitch +28 deg.
